risk_summary: The company reports substantial recurring losses, limited operating history, negative cash-flow concerns, and an explicit going-concern doubt. Its funding plan relies partly on nonbinding oral commitments from directors, while profitability and financing assumptions remain uncertain. Extensive forward-looking and accounting-standard boilerplate adds limited incremental insight into near-term liquidity risk.
